title: AudioCuesPlan
description: Time-ordered audio cues for downstream knowledge search + mix. Pure domain data; frontend infers rendering from field names and array shape (no UI fields).

title.description: Retrieval-friendly sound description, 5-15 words. Consumed verbatim by `dl knowledge search` in Phase 04.

start_time.description: Seconds from video start. Combined with `duration` enables the auto timeline view.

duration.description: Length in seconds. Omit for one-shot cues (STINGER / BGMSTOP).
